body.title: Rewire readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch to orchestrate the new checks
body.summary: Rewrite readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch (cli-provider.ts:604-619) to, in order: call walkProjectMcpConfigLayers(exec.cwd) and throw CodexProjectMcpServersUnexcludableError if true; write the schema temp file as today; call discoverCodexMcpServers(this.binPath, exec.cwd, exec.timeoutMs, exec.signal); recompute the remaining budget and throw ReadOnlySessionTimeoutError if exhausted; call the new codexReadOnlySessionArgs with the discovery result; call runCodex (unmodified) with the recomputed timeoutMs; parse the reply exactly as today.
acceptanceChecks: readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexProjectMcpServersUnexcludableError and calls neither discoverCodexMcpServers nor runCodex when walkProjectMcpConfigLayers returns true
readOnlySessionOnce calls runCodex with the recomputed remaining timeoutMs, not the original, after discovery consumes part of the budget
readOnlySessionOnce throws ReadOnlySessionTimeoutError and never calls runCodex when discovery consumes the entire remaining budget
readOnlySessionOnce's existing claude/vibe branches and its post-exec reply-parsing logic are unchanged
